name: e_ducks_under_platform
description: Alternative use of the 5 ducks: all under the Raised Platform (3 pts + Base 1 each, no multiplier), Botguy untouched (+1 Base). Scores 21 versus 30 for b_ducks_only. A mixed split beats both when nothing else scores (3 zone ducks + 2 under the platform = 36), but once the rest of the subtotal reaches 8 points all 5 ducks belong in zones (tools/score.py best_duck_allocation).
